120.manual_summary: The traction drive unit temperature has exceeded the normal operating range. This condition indicates insufficient cooling or excessive load during operation.
actions_summary: Check cooling system operation and airflow
Inspect for overload or prolonged high-demand operation
Allow the unit to cool and verify temperature sensors

130.manual_summary: The accelerator input is detected while the seat safety switch is not active. The system prevents traction to ensure operator presence.
actions_summary: Check seat switch function and wiring
Verify correct seating and switch actuation
Inspect for damaged or misadjusted microswitch

131.manual_summary: The onboard charger is connected to mains power while a drive command is present. Traction is inhibited for safety reasons.
actions_summary: Disconnect the charger from the power supply
Verify accelerator input is inactive during charging

132.manual_summary: A drive command is detected while the onboard charger connector is not seated in the vehicle. This indicates an invalid charging or traction state.

150.manual_summary: The remaining battery capacity has dropped to a low threshold level. Performance may be limited to protect the battery.

151.manual_summary: The remaining battery capacity has reached a critical low level. Vehicle functions may be significantly restricted.

188.manual_summary: The left traction power module has detected an internal fault condition. Traction performance may be limited or disabled.
actions_summary: Check power module status and fault memory
Perform diagnostic test on the module

189.manual_summary: The right traction power module has detected an internal fault condition. This may result in reduced or disabled traction.
actions_summary: Test the module for internal faults

190.manual_summary: The steering axle is mechanically locked by the battery hydraulic compartment. Steering movement is restricted.
actions_summary: Check hydraulic components related to steering lock
Ensure no mechanical obstruction is present

200.manual_summary: The control module manufacturing or initialization test was not completed successfully. The module may not be correctly configured.
actions_summary: Repeat initialization or factory test procedure
Check for software or parameter issues

201.manual_summary: The internal software monitoring function of the control module has triggered a response, indicating abnormal operation.
actions_summary: Cycle power and observe fault recurrence
Inspect for electromagnetic interference or voltage issues

210.manual_summary: The supply voltage for traction-related sensors is above the permissible range. Sensor readings may be unreliable.
actions_summary: Check for short circuits or incorrect supply sources

211.manual_summary: The supply voltage for traction-related sensors is below the permissible range. This can cause invalid sensor signals.

212.manual_summary: The traction sensor supply voltage is outside valid operating limits. Sensor data cannot be trusted.

231.manual_summary: The accelerator guidance signal is outside the expected operating range. The control system detects an implausible input.
actions_summary: Inspect wiring for damage or loose connections

232.manual_summary: The accelerator reference signal is outside the permitted range. This prevents reliable traction control.

233.manual_summary: The accelerator guidance and reference signals do not correlate correctly. The system detects implausible pedal input.

241.manual_summary: The signal from channel 1 of the steering angle sensor is outside the valid range. Steering feedback may be unreliable.

242.manual_summary: The signal from channel 2 of the steering angle sensor is outside the valid range. Redundant signal monitoring has failed.

243.manual_summary: The two steering angle sensor channels provide incompatible signals. Steering position cannot be validated.
actions_summary: Replace sensor if signals remain inconsistent

351.manual_summary: The detected traction motor temperature is outside the permissible range. This indicates abnormal thermal conditions.

353.manual_summary: The traction motor temperature has exceeded the allowable limit. Protective measures may limit performance.

391.manual_summary: The oil temperature sensor signal is invalid or incorrect. Temperature-dependent functions may be affected.
actions_summary: Verify sensor readings against actual temperature

440.manual_summary: The steering angle signal is outside the valid operating range. Steering control accuracy cannot be ensured.

491.manual_summary: The safety check of the traction power module has failed. The system detects a potential safety-related fault.
actions_summary: Reset system and recheck safety status

502.manual_summary: The brake pressure signal is outside the permitted range. Correct braking performance cannot be guaranteed.

614.manual_summary: The seat switch signals are implausible, indicating both contacts are open or closed simultaneously. Operator presence cannot be confirmed.
actions_summary: Check wiring for shorts or open circuits

750.manual_summary: Traction has been disabled by the safety processor due to detected unsafe conditions. Vehicle movement is prevented.
actions_summary: Inspect related safety inputs and signals
Clear fault and perform safety check
